qualifier: As modeled conceptually, subject to change once we survey our specific bus, Earl Thomas.
interpretation: Integer ceilings of a selected normal-stress screen. Operating occupancy, deflection/vibration suitability and whole-structure safety remain unestablished.

criteria.liveLoadMultiplier: Selected equivalent-static sensitivity; not a bound on rhythmic forces
criteria.stressCeiling: 0.60 times assumed yield; simplified project screen, not code compliance
criteria.headcountSearch: Direct integer solutions, stop at first exceedance; default scenario additionally solved through 30 for comparison

unchangedGeometry.shore_assumption: One compression-only vertical shore per longitudinal edge girder at the midpoint between the interior bearers; effective stiffness includes prop, seats, Thomas body structure and its chassis load path.
unchangedGeometry.corners_assumption: Both rear corners transfer gravity through the rear drop-frame into the chassis rails, with the same analytical sill sections and fixed rail-seat restraint as the front portal. The participating load is solved, not assigned as a fraction.
unchangedGeometry.shore_mass: New shore and bracket weights remain unassigned; results contain the changed roof frame and plywood only.

modelShoring.status: Display dimensions only, unverified sections and structural landing geometry
